    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Action
    Represents a pending game action assigned to a specific player.
    ActionsDTO
    Carries the set of actions still available to the active player for the current turn.
    ApplicableActions
    Exposes the three player-driven actions that the GameManager can receive during a match.
    AskLobbiesMessage
    Sent by the client to request the list of currently available game lobbies.
    AvailableLobbiesMessage
    Sent by the server in response to an AskLobbiesMessage, carrying the current list of open game lobbies.
    BoardDTO
    A snapshot of the complete game board state.
    Builder
    A character card representing a builder villager.
    Building
    Represents a building card that a player can acquire during the game.
    CanDrawVisitor
    Visitor that determines whether the current player can or must draw a card.
    Card
    Abstract base class for all cards in the game.
    CardColorMapper
    Utility class that maps character card types to their corresponding ANSI RGB colors for use in the TUI.
    CardData
    Represents the static data associated with a game card, as loaded from the client-side JSON resource file.
    CardDTO
    Represents a single card transferred between server and client.
    CardEffectInstant
    Abstract base class for instant card effects.
    CardEffectInteractive
    Abstract base class for interactive card effects.
    CardGUI
    JavaFX component that represents a game card in the GUI.
    CardImagesLoader
    Singleton responsible for loading and caching all card images used in the GUI.
    CardInfoHelper
    Utility class that formats card details for display in the TUI.
    CardRegistry
    Static registry that holds all card data loaded from the client-side JSON resource file.
    CardTypeEnum
    Represents the type of card in the game.
    CardVisitor
    Visitor interface for the three main card types in the game.
    ChangeAgeDTO
    Carries the data needed to update the client when the game advances to a new age (era).
    ChangeAgeUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when the game advances to a new age, carrying the refreshed card rows and deck size.
    Character
    Abstract base class for all character cards.
    Client
    Abstract base class for all client implementations.
    ClientHandler
    Abstract base class for server-side client handlers.
    ClientHandler.CheckedRunnable
    Functional interface for actions that may throw checked exceptions.
    ClientHandlerRmi
    Server-side RMI handler for a connected client.
    ClientHandlerSocket
    Server-side socket handler for a connected client.
    ClientMain
    Entry point for the client application.
    ClientMessage
    Marker interface for all messages sent from a client to the server over a socket connection.
    ClientMessageVisitor
    Visitor for messages sent from the client to the server.
    ClientMessageVisitorImpl
    Concrete implementation of ClientMessageVisitor.
    ClientRmi
    RMI implementation of Client.
    ClientSocket
    Socket (TCP) implementation of Client.
    ClientToServerActions
    Defines the set of actions a client can send to the server.
    ColorPawnEnum
    Represents the available colors for player pawns.
    Command
    Represents a command that can be executed by a client in the game.
    CommandParser
    Utility class that parses raw TUI input strings into Command instances.
    Controller
    Controller class that handles messages sent by clients during the game.
    Crafter
    A character card representing a crafter villager.
    CrafterSymbolEnum
    Represents the symbols associated with crafter cards.
    CrafterSymbolMapper
    Utility class that maps CrafterSymbolEnum values to their corresponding Unicode emoji representations for display in the TUI.
    CreateGameCommand
    Command that requests the creation of a new game match.
    CreateGameMessage
    Sent by the client to request the creation of a new game lobby.
    CurrPlayerUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when the active player changes.
    CursorManager
    Utility class that manages custom cursors across the GUI.
    DBManager
    Utility class for obtaining JDBC connections to the application database.
    DeckGUI
    JavaFX component that represents the card deck in the GUI.
    DisconnectionListener
    Callback interface used to notify the server when a client can no longer be reached, regardless of the underlying transport (RMI or socket).
    DiscountFood
    An instant effect that applies a cost discount to the owning player.
    DiscountFoodEnum
    Represents the available food discount effects that can be applied to a player.
    DiscountFoodModifier
    Strategy interface for the different discount behaviours a card can apply to a player's future costs.
    DrawCard
    An interactive card effect that grants the owning player a card draw.
    DrawCardCommand
    Command that requests the drawing of a card from the game.
    DrawCardEnum
    Represents the available card draw modes in the game.
    DrawCardVisitor
    Visitor that executes the draw action for a card on behalf of the current player.
    DrawCountVisitor
    Visitor that accumulates the total number of upper- and lower-row draw actions granted by DrawCard effects.
    DrawMessage
    Sent by the client when the player draws a card.
    DrawPhaseState
    Game phase in which players resolve card draw actions triggered by board tile effects.
    DrawUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when a player draws a card.
    EndGamePhaseState
    Terminal game phase in which final scores are calculated and the match winner is determined.
    EndGameScreen
    TUI screen displayed at the end of a match.
    EndRoundPhaseState
    Game phase that runs at the end of each round, after all players have resolved their draw actions.
    EndTurnPhaseState
    Game phase that runs at the end of a single player's turn, returning them to the queue and triggering any queue tile effects.
    ErrorMessage
    Sent by the server to relay a generic error message to the client.
    Event
    Abstract base class for event cards.
    EventDTO
    Bundles the outcome of a card-event phase for transmission to all clients.
    EventMessage
    Sent by the server when one or more card effects are resolved during a turn, carrying the triggered events and the resulting player statistics.
    EventScreen
    TUI screen displayed at the end of each round to show the events that triggered and their effects on each player.
    ExitCommand
    Command that terminates the client application.
    ExitMessage
    Sent by the client when the player terminates the session and disconnects from the server.
    Feast
    An event card that triggers a feast, requiring each player to feed their village characters.
    FlagData
    Represents the display data associated with a player status flag, as loaded from the client-side JSON resource file.
    FlagRegistry
    Static registry that maps flag names to their descriptions, loaded at class initialisation time from the /json/clientFlags.json resource file.
    GainFood
    An instant effect that grants food to the owning player.
    GainFoodEnum
    Represents the available food gain effects that can be applied to a player.
    GainFoodModifier
    Strategy interface for the different food gain behaviours a card can trigger.
    GainPP
    An instant effect that grants prestige points to the owning player.
    GainPPEnum
    Represents the available prestige points (PP) gain effects that can be applied to a player.
    GainPPModifier
    Strategy interface for the different prestige point gain behaviours a card can trigger.
    GainStars
    An instant effect that grants stars to the owning player.
    GainStarsEnum
    Represents the available stars gain effects that can be applied to a player.
    GainStarsModifier
    Strategy interface for star gain behaviours a card can trigger.
    GameController
    JavaFX controller for the main in-game screen (gameBoard.fxml).
    GameController.VillageOverlay
    Immutable value object that groups the three JavaFX nodes making up a single opponent's village overlay.
    GameCreatedMessage
    Sent by the server to the player who created a lobby, confirming the creation and providing the assigned match ID.
    GameEndingUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server to each client when the game ends, carrying the final statistics and the recipient player's ranking positions.
    GameException
    General-purpose exception thrown when an unexpected error occurs during the game.
    GameInitializer
    Responsible for initializing all game components at the start of a match.
    GameJoinedMessage
    Sent by the server to a player who successfully joined an existing lobby, confirming the match ID they have entered.
    GameManager
    Core model class for a single game session.
    GameMessageVisitor
    Visitor for in-game action messages sent by the client.
    GameNotifier
    Broadcasts game events to all registered ModelObserver instances.
    GamePhaseEnum
    Represents the possible phases of a game turn or round.
    GamePhaseState
    Represents a single state in the game phase state machine.
    GameSnapshot
    Immutable snapshot of the full game state at a given point in time.
    GameSnapshot.PendingAction
    Represents a game action that has been triggered but not yet completed.
    GameState
    Holds and manages all mutable game data for a single match.
    GameStateDAO
    Data Access Object for persisting and retrieving GameSnapshot instances.
    Gatherer
    A character card representing a gatherer villager.
    HelpCommand
    Command that displays the list of available commands to the client.
    HelpScreen
    TUI screen that displays the list of all available commands and their descriptions.
    HelpScreen.Explanation
    Holds the syntax and description of a single TUI command, used to populate the help screen entries.
    Hunt
    An event card that rewards players for the hunters in their village.
    Hunter
    A character card representing a hunter villager.
    InfoCommand
    The command that displays the info of the card selected
    InteractiveEffectModifier
    Strategy interface for creating the Action produced by an interactive card effect.
    InvalidCardException
    Exception thrown when an invalid or unrecognized card is used during the game.
    InvalidDrawException
    Exception thrown when an invalid or unrecognized draw action is used during the game.
    InvalidLobbyException
    Exception thrown when an invalid or unrecognized lobby is selected.
    InvalidLobbySizeException
    Exception thrown when an invalid lobby size is specified during lobby creation.
    InvalidMoveException
    Exception thrown when an invalid or unrecognized tile is selected to move into.
    InvalidPhaseException
    Exception thrown when an action is performed during an invalid game phase.
    InvalidPlayerException
    Exception thrown when a player tries to do an action not during his turn.
    InvalidSkipException
    Exception thrown when an invalid skip is requested during the game.
    InvalidTimingException
    Exception thrown when a command is issued outside its valid context: either a lobby command is issued while a match is already in progress, or a game command is issued before joining a match.
    InvalidUsernameException
    Exception thrown when a player tries to register an invalid username: either already in use or blank/null.
    JoinGameCommand
    Command that requests the client to join an existing game lobby.
    JoinGameMessage
    Sent by the client to request joining an existing game lobby.
    Launcher
    Launcher class for the client application.
    LauncherApp
    JavaFX entry point for the Mesos GUI client.
    LeaderboardController
    JavaFX controller for the end-game leaderboard screen (leaderboardBoard.fxml).
    Lobby
    Represents a game lobby waiting for players before a match starts.
    LobbyDTO
    Represents a game lobby waiting for players to join.
    LoginFailedMessage
    Sent by the server when a login request is rejected.
    LoginMessage
    Sent by the client to register a nickname with the server and start a session.
    LoginSuccessMessage
    Sent by the server to confirm that a login request was accepted.
    LossIfBroke
    An instant effect that penalises a player who cannot pay a food cost.
    LossIfBrokeEnum
    Represents the penalty effect applied to a player when they cannot afford a food cost.
    LossIfBrokeModifier
    Strategy interface for the penalty applied to a player who cannot pay a food cost.
    MainMenuController
    Controller for the main menu scene in the GUI.
    MatchManager
    Central server-side coordinator for all game sessions.
    ModelObserver
    Observer interface through which the model (and server-side logic) notifies a connected player of game events.
    MoveCommand
    Command that requests the player's token to be placed on a specific tile of the board.
    MoveMessage
    Sent by the client to place the player's pawn on a board tile.
    MoveUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when a player places their pawn on a board tile.
    NetworkType
    Represents the available network connection types for the game.
    NotifyDrawableMessage
    Sent by the server to the active player when they become eligible to draw one or more cards, carrying the updated action budget.
    NotifySkipMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when a player skips their remaining actions for the current turn.
    OccupiedTileException
    Exception thrown when an already occupied tile is selected to move into.
    OptionalDrawPhaseState
    Game phase in which players resolve their pending skippable draw actions.
    Painter
    A character card representing a painter villager.
    PawnImagesLoader
    Singleton responsible for loading and caching the pawn images used in the GUI.
    PersistenceManager
    Manages the persistence lifecycle of active matches.
    PhaseDTO
    Carries the current phase of the game.
    PhaseUpdateMessage
    Broadcast by the server to all clients when the game transitions to a new phase.
    PingMessage
    Sent by the server at regular intervals to verify that the client is still reachable.
    Player
    Represents a player in the game, holding all their resources, bonuses, buildings, and village state.
    PlayerDTO
    Represents a player as seen by the client.
    PlayerStatsDTO
    Carries the current numerical statistics for a single player.
    PlayerStatusDTO
    Carries the boolean status flags and active discounts for a single player.
    PlayEventPhaseState
    Game phase in which the two final event cards are played at the end of the last age, before scores are calculated.
    PlayEventVisitor
    Visitor that executes event cards during the event phase of a round.
    PongMessage
    Sent by the client in response to a PingMessage to signal that the connection is still alive.
    PopupPane
    Abstract base class for interactive GUI elements that display a styled tooltip on hover, used throughout the game board to represent visual game objects such as CardGUI, TileGUI, and QTileGUI.
    ProtectPP
    An instant effect that activates prestige point loss protection on the owning player.
    ProtectPPEnum
    Represents the PP protection effect that can be applied to a player.
    ProtectPPModifier
    Strategy interface for activating prestige point loss protection on a player.
    QTileData
    Represents the static display data associated with a board tile, as loaded from the client-side JSON resource file.
    QTileGUI
    GUI component representing a Queue Tile on the game board.
    QTileImagesLoader
    Singleton image loader for Queue Tile front-face images.
    QTileRegistry
    Static registry that holds all board tile data loaded from the client-side JSON resource file.
    QuitAckMessage
    Sent by the server to acknowledge a QuitMessage, confirming that the player has been removed from the match and providing a reason or summary message.
    QuitCommand
    Command that makes the player leave the current match, lobby, or post-game screen while remaining connected to the server.
    QuitMessage
    Sent by the client when the player voluntarily leaves the current match without closing the session.
    RankingCalculator
    Computes the final ranking and global ranking point awards for a match.
    RankingDAO
    Data Access Object for player credentials and match ranking data.
    RankingRequestCommand
    Command that requests the global leaderboard from the server.
    RankingRequestMessage
    Sent by the client to request the global ranking leaderboard from the server.
    RankingResponseMessage
    Sent by the server in response to a RankingRequestMessage, carrying the global leaderboard: the cumulative score each player has accumulated across all matches played with the same number of players.
    RankingScreen
    TUI screen that displays the global leaderboard for matches played with a specific number of players.
    ReconnectionMessage
    Sent by the server to a client that has reconnected to an ongoing match, providing the match ID so the client can restore its state.
    RequestLeaderboardUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server after the game ends with the global leaderboard, mapping each player to their overall position across all matches.
    RestoredGameManager
    A GameManager that restores a previously saved match from a GameSnapshot.
    ReturnToQueueUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server to a player who has been returned to the waiting queue.
    Ritual
    An event card that rewards the player with the most stars and penalises the player with the fewest.
    SceneManager
    Manages named root Parent nodes for the application's primary Stage.
    ScrollPlayersCommand
    Command that scrolls the players panel in the TUI by a fixed number of rows.
    ServerMain
    Application entry point for the game server.
    ServerMessage
    Marker interface for all messages sent from the server to a client over a socket connection.
    ServerMessageVisitor
    Visitor for messages sent from the server to the client.
    ServerMessageVisitorImpl
    Concrete implementation of ServerMessageVisitor.
    ServerRmi
    RMI server stub registered in the RMI registry under the name "GameServer".
    ServerSocket
    TCP socket listener that accepts incoming client connections.
    SetupPhaseState
    Game phase in which all players move their pawn onto a board tile.
    Shaman
    A character card representing a shaman villager.
    ShowBoardMessage
    Sent by the server with the full board state, typically at game start or after a client reconnects, so the client can rebuild its local model.
    ShowLobbiesCommand
    Command that requests the list of currently available lobbies from the server.
    SkipDrawCommand
    Command that requests to skip the current optional draw action.
    SkipMessage
    Sent by the client when the player chooses to skip their remaining actions for the current turn.
    Snapshotable
    Marks a class as capable of serializing its current state into a GameSnapshot.
    SplashController
    FXML controller for the splash screen shown during application startup.
    StatsPanel
    Collapsible side panel displaying the opponent players' statistics during a game session.
    StatsUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server when a player's statistics change.
    StatusCommand
    Command that displays the current game status screen to the client.
    StatusScreen
    TUI screen that displays the active status flags of all players in the current match.
    StatusScreen.FlagEntry
    Associates a display label with a StatusScreen.FlagReader that checks whether the corresponding flag is active for a given player.
    StatusScreen.FlagReader
    Functional interface for reading a single boolean flag from a PlayerStatusDTO.
    StatusUpdateMessage
    Sent by the server when a player's status flags change.
    StonePainting
    An event card that rewards players with many painters and penalises those with few.
    Tile
    Represents a single tile on the game board or in the queue.
    TileData
    Represents the static display data associated with a board tile, as loaded from the client-side JSON resource file.
    TileData.HighlightBounds
    Defines the pixel bounds of a highlighted rectangular area overlaid on a tile image.
    TileDTO
    Represents a single board tile as transferred between server and client.
    TileGUI
    GUI component representing a board tile that players can place their pawn on.
    TileImagesLoader
    Singleton responsible for loading and caching the front-face images of all game tiles used in the GUI.
    TileRegistry
    Static registry that holds all board tile data loaded from the client-side JSON resource file.
    TotemGUI
    JavaFX component that renders a player's totem (pawn) image in the GUI.
    TUIColorMapper
    Utility class that maps player pawn colors to their corresponding JLine ANSI styles for use in the TUI.
    TUICompleter
    JLine Completer that provides context-aware tab-completion for TUI commands.
    UIType
    Represents the available user interface types for the game client.
    UserInterface
    Defines the contract for the client-side user interface, abstracting over the TUI and GUI implementations.
    ViewGUI
    JavaFX implementation of UserInterface that bridges incoming server notifications with the GUI layer.
    ViewTUI
    Text-based user interface for the Mesos game, implementing UserInterface.
    ViewTUI.LayoutTier
    Responsive breakpoints that control the column-width proportions of the three-panel layout.
    ViewTUI.LogEntry
    Immutable container for a single log entry, pairing the display text with its AttributedStyle.
    Village
    Represents a player's village: the collection of character cards they have played during the game.
    Village.BuilderPointsSum
    Visitor that sums the prestige point contributions of all Builder cards in the village.
    Village.CrafterSymbolCounter
    Visitor that counts how many Crafter cards in the village carry a specific CrafterSymbolEnum.
    Village.SymbolRetriever
    Visitor that extracts the CrafterSymbolEnum carried by a card, if the card is a Crafter.
    VillagePanel
    A floating, slide-able drawer panel that displays the local player's village (their hand of played cards) anchored to the bottom of the game scene.
    VillageVisitor
    Visitor for character cards present in a player's village.
    VirtualModel
    Client-side model that mirrors the authoritative game state held by the server.
    VirtualServerRmi
    Extends Remote so that its methods can be called by clients over the RMI registry.
    VirtualView
    Represents the server-side view of a client connected via Socket.
    VirtualViewRmi
    Remote interface through which the server pushes game state updates to the client.
